mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS) indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation models, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth rate exceeding 0.5% monthly (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank hawkishness, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production levels (INDPRO) above 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicate robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicate a high-inflation, high-rate environment that suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing sector that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000 over any 3-year rolling window.
